title: Connection strings with quoted values
prompt:
`ParseKV` in config/kv.go reads connection strings like `host=db.local; user=app; password="p;w=d"; port = 5432` but
breaks when a quoted value contains `;` or `=`, keeps the spaces around keys and values, and silently accepts a pair
with no `=`. Fix it: pairs are separated by `;`, whitespace around keys and values is trimmed, a value in double quotes
may contain `;`, `=` and `\"` (an escaped quote), empty pairs are ignored, and a pair without `=`, an empty key or an
unterminated quote returns an error.
